Silchester International Investors Llp Lifted Position in Sk Telecom LTD (SKM); Noesis Capital Mangement Raised Its Apple (AAPL) Holding
April 30, 2018 - By Michael Collier
Noesis Capital Mangement Corp increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 10.33% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Noesis Capital Mangement Corp bought 1,782 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 19,026 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.22 million, up from 17,244 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Noesis Capital Mangement Corp who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $838.68 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.83% or $2.97 during the last trading session, reaching $165.29. About 30.83 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 30, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Silchester International Investors Llp increased its stake in Sk Telecom Ltd (SKM) by 1.35% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Silchester International Investors Llp bought 193,674 shares as the company’s stock declined 17.66% with the market. The institutional investor held 14.56 million shares of the public utilities company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $406.25M, up from 14.36 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Silchester International Investors Llp who had been investing in Sk Telecom Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $14.98 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.42% or $0.34 during the last trading session, reaching $23.62. About 323,987 shares traded. SK Telecom Co., Ltd. (NYSE:SKM) has declined 9.74% since April 30, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 21.29% the S&P500.
Silchester International Investors Llp, which manages about $36.50B and $2.21 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Vale S A (NYSE:VALE) by 7.97 million shares to 36.50M shares, valued at $446.42M in 2017Q4, according to the filing.
Among 5 analysts covering SK Telecom ( NYSE:SKM ), 2 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 3 Hold. Therefore 40% are positive. SK Telecom had 5 analyst reports since November 2, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. CLSA upgraded the shares of SKM in report on Monday, October 24 to “Buy” rating. Macquarie Research downgraded the stock to “Neutral” rating in Tuesday, October 25 report. The rating was downgraded by HSBC on Wednesday, April 27 to “Hold”. On Monday, November 2 the stock rating was downgraded by JP Morgan to “Neutral”. As per Friday, December 1, the company rating was upgraded by Citigroup.
Among 54 analysts covering Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ:AAPL ), 35 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 18 Hold. Therefore 65% are positive. Apple Inc. had 402 analyst reports since July 21, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm has “Overweight” rating given on Wednesday, October 26 by PiperJaffray. J.P. Morgan maintained it with “Buy” rating and $176.0 target in Wednesday, September 13 report. The firm has “Market Perform” rating given on Friday, February 16 by Raymond James. FBR Capital maintained Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) rating on Friday, February 12. FBR Capital has “Outperform” rating and $120 target. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Wednesday, August 2 by Citigroup. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Friday, January 12 by Piper Jaffray. The rating was maintained by Loop Capital with “Buy” on Wednesday, January 31. Canaccord Genuity maintained the shares of AAPL in report on Friday, November 3 with “Buy” rating. The company was maintained on Monday, July 24 by BMO Capital Markets. The rating was upgraded by Mizuho on Monday, January 11 to “Buy”.
Since December 7, 2017, it had 0 insider purchases, and 5 selling transactions for $26.72 million activity. Riccio Daniel J. also sold $2.94 million worth of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) on Wednesday, April 4. 39,122 shares were sold by Maestri Luca, worth $6.83M on Thursday, April 12.
